major_scenes.environment_description: A spacious, utilitarian ship interior located below deck. The room is characterized by rows of white-painted steel structural columns with visible rivets running from floor to ceiling. A wide staircase with white metal sides and a polished wooden handrail descends into the main area. The walls are painted white and feature a series of circular porthole windows that allow bright, cool daylight to flood the space. The flooring is a smooth, light-colored surface. The area is furnished with rows of simple, sturdy wooden benches with vertical slat backs and plain wooden tables. The ceiling is low with exposed beams, reinforcing the industrial maritime architecture. The lighting is bright and even, combining natural light from the portholes with ambient interior illumination.

major_scenes.environment_description: An exterior promenade deck of a large ocean liner at night. The flooring consists of dark, varnished wooden planks laid lengthwise, reflecting the ambient light. On the left side, the ship's white superstructure rises, featuring large cylindrical ventilators, steel walls with rivet details, and cabin windows. Rows of wooden deck chairs with slat construction are folded and stacked or lined up against the wall. On the right, a white metal railing guards the edge of the ship against the open sea. Overhead, a deep blue night sky is visible, scattered with bright stars. Warm, yellow artificial light emanates from fixtures on the ship's walls, illuminating the white steel and casting soft shadows across the wooden deck.
